description.p: Doctor NoX looks at the parts of a Linux system that tend to go wrong and explains what it finds: pending restarts and package problems, image deployments on Fedora Atomic and other OSTree systems, SELinux or AppArmor, failed services, graphics drivers and game controllers, disk space, Flatpak and Snap, the network and boot errors.
It only looks. It never needs administrator rights, never changes anything and never connects to the internet. Reports can be saved with personal details removed for sharing.
It knows Fedora (including Atomic desktops and bootc), Debian and Ubuntu, Arch and SteamOS, and openSUSE, and runs its general checks on any other Linux.
First release for every Linux: Fedora (including Atomic and bootc), Debian, Ubuntu, Arch, SteamOS and openSUSE.
